thread:
Alex V.: I’m taking a quick handoff — primary for the next 4h. Maria is on travel and will be secondary until 04:30UTC. FYI there’s a planned infra kernel rollback at 03:30UTC that might affect model-serving pods.
SRE-Bot: alert: scheduled-maintenance: kernel-rollback-starting in 20m for infra-group-1.
Maria C.: tagging in — I’ll be reachable by phone but no laptop for first 45m. If anything SEV>=2, page Sam directly.
Alex V.: noted. Coverage gap from 03:30–04:15UTC if rollback causes node reboots; I’ll stand a short bridge during that window.
Sam R.: I’m 2nd-level for GPU infra today, reachable via pager+sms. If we see >1 zone drop or sustained 50% qps loss, escalate to me immediately.
Jess L.: quick reminder: runbook link -> https://internal.runbooks.redwood/serving/zone-deg. Use the mitigation steps in "fallback-to-mirrors" first.
Alex V.: copying important runbook snippet: ```
# quick mitigation commands
kubectl scale deployment serving-mirrors --replicas=3 -n prod
curl -sS http://internal-proxy/health | jq .status
```
Priya K.: FYI CS is seeing two customers reporting elevated latency on EU region. CS-Bot posted tickets #5432 and #5433.
CS-Bot: customer-alert: tickets created -> 5432,5433. Severity: customer-impacting latency.
Alex V.: thanks Priya. Initial triage: qps is steady but p50 p95 both up. Not seeing increased error rate yet.
SRE-Bot: pager: SEV2 incident created for model-serving-eu at 2991112305 (unacked).
Alex V.: unacked SEV2 — paging sequence: primary (me), secondary (Maria), infra-sre (Sam), slo-eng lead (Jess). If no ack in 10m, escalate to eng-oncall manager.
Maria C.: acked. I can take the pager if Alex needs to trigger wider mitigations.
Sam R.: looking at metrics — node reboot events starting at 03:33UTC in eu-west-2, containers restarting but restart-loop count low. Kernel-rollback might be the cause. Will confirm with infra console.
Alex V.: Action plan: 1) enable prefix KV cache for EU model pool, 2) scale mirrors, 3) if errors appear, failover traffic to US mirrors. Start 1 and 2 now.
Jess L.: adding runbook pointer: when failover happens, update routing policy in console and flip the canary to fallback-region. Document the time.
Alex V.: executing step 1/2 now. Pasting commands below (running):
```bash
# scale mirrors
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/model-serving-mirrors-eu --replicas=3
# enable prefix cache
redwoodctl cache enable --region eu --type prefix
```
SRE-Bot: event: user-triggered-mitigation by Alex V. (scale mirrors, enable cache).
Priya K.: CS: Notifying affected customers we've acknowledged and are mitigating. ETA 30m.
Sam R.: infra confirms kernel rollback in eu-west-2 started and 2/12 nodes are still rebooting. No disk corruption. Reboots should finish in ~12m.
Alex V.: good. Monitor for error spikes. If any 5xx > 0.5% for 5m, escalate to SEV1 and page oncall@redwood (pager escalation).
Jess L.: remember escalation matrix: SEV2 unacked 10m -> page infra-sre; SEV1 immediate page to oncall pager and SRE lead; P0 -> page CTO and incident commander. Keep notes in the incident doc.
Maria C.: confirmed I’ll take over primary at 03:55UTC if Alex needs a break.
Alex V.: handing status for next 15m: mitigation in progress, mirrors scaled, cache on. Watching latencies.
SRE-Bot: metric-alert: p95_latency_eu increased -> triggered at 2991112470.
Alex V.: saw that. p95 trending down after scale ~2991112485.
Priya K.: CS: customers acknowledged update; one asks for a timeline on SLA credits — we’ll need post-incident note.
Sam R.: 3/12 nodes still rebooting; kube-scheduler rescheduling pods slowly. I’ll open a ticket with infra-op to delay remaining rollbacks in the same az.
Alex V.: Sam, please do. If reboots keep causing >20% capacity loss, we’ll trigger cross-region routing.
Sam R.: acknowledged, filing ops ticket now.
Jess L.: note to self: when handing over, include these items in the summary: root cause hypothesis (kernel rollback), mitigation steps taken, customers impacted, times of each mitigation, followups for infra coordination.
Alex V.: ok team — my last update before short break: mirrors stable, cache enabled, p95 improving. I’ll be back at 03:50UTC. Maria to be primary if anything new after 03:55UTC.
Maria C.: ack. I’ll monitor and will escalate per the rules above.
SRE-Bot: incident update: severity remains SEV2 -> commented by Maria C. at 2991112750.
Alex V.: back online. Looks stable; closing active mitigations but keeping the bridge open for 20m. Please add any notes to the incident doc.
Priya K.: CS: Logged customer updates and asked for postmortem. We’ll coordinate on the timeline for comms.
Jess L.: will own the postmortem doc. Please ping me with timestamps and any logs you saved (kubectl outputs, cache toggle events).
Alex V.: saved command outputs to /tmp/mitigation-2991112222.log and uploaded to incident doc.
Sam R.: infra ops paused the remaining rollbacks in eu-west-2 at 03:44UTC. That seems to have prevented further reboots.
Maria C.: closing out from my side. No further latency spikes in last 10m. If anything new crops up, page Sam then Jess.
Alex V.: thank you, team. I’ll mark the thread resolved after Jess posts the postmortem stub. :thumbsup:
SRE-Bot: incident-resolved-checklist: mitigations completed, followups assigned, postmortem owner: Jess L.
Jess L.: creating postmortem shell now. We’ll schedule a 30m blameless review at 10:00UTC.
Alex V.: leaving final note: escalation rules followed, secondary coverage gap covered by bridge, recommend adding travel backup for secondaries in scheduler to avoid pockets of reduced coverage.
Maria C.: +1 on travel backup. Also suggest an automated check that alerts if a scheduled maintenance overlaps with an oncall with travel flagged.
Alex V.: good idea — filing a ticket for that.
SRE-Bot: thread closed at 2991112850.
